title: Reset password
content: To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the link we send you. The link expires after 30 minutes.

title: Refund policy
content: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase from Account > Orders > Request refund. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

title: Shipping times
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. You receive a tracking number by email once the order ships.

title: Cancel subscription
content: Go to Account > Subscription > Cancel. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

title: Contact support
content: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9am-6pm, via chat or support@example.com.
